about: Shared cases for the page colours the launcher's name sheet takes (CONTRACT.md §2), run by both apps' unit tests (SheetColorsTest.kt, SheetColorsTests.swift). The input is a computed-style colour as the page's script returns it, untrusted; a case expects the opaque sRGB colour [r, g, b], or null for none (the launcher's own palette).

cases.note: alpha is dropped: the sheet surface is opaque
